title: Build a deterministic Base agent-wallet transaction review CLI
goal: Implement a dependency-free read-only CLI that converts a Base USDC wallet action plan into a deterministic human confirmation card and rejects unsafe inputs.
acceptance_criteria: Add solution/scripts/render-agent-wallet-review.mjs and accept exactly one JSON file path argument.

For valid Base-mainnet native-USDC claim or fund plans, emit exactly one compact deterministic JSON line with normalized addresses, a human-readable amount, exact allowance scope, gas asset, expected event, and no warnings; write nothing to stderr and exit zero.

Reject wrong network or token, invalid or zero addresses, non-positive non-decimal amounts, allowance amount different from the action amount, allowance spender different from the target contract, unexpected events, and recursively embedded secret fields; emit the committed ordered error list and exit one.
For wrong argument count, unreadable input, malformed JSON, or a non-object root, emit the committed single error and exit two.
Use only Node.js built-ins and perform no network requests, signing, transaction broadcast, or file writes.
Pass every test in the immutable benchmark and produce byte-identical output for repeated identical input.
